data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6107's gross claims outstanding at the start of 2019 was $97.681m (US$). During 2019 the syndicate's overall claims provisions increased, driven primarily by material catastrophe losses arising from natural catastrophe events in 2017 and 2018 and further catastrophe impact in 2019 (Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai). The property reinsurance portfolio was the main driver of adverse development, partly offset by profitable performance in the syndicate's cyber business. The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prioryear reserve movement figure; detailed development tables and technical provisions are provided but a discrete gross prioryear movement amount is not stated.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate has incurred material losses as a result of the natural catastrophe events of 2017 and 2018.
The 2019 underwriting year has been impacted by the natural catastrophe events of Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan.
The growth of the syndicate's cyber book highlights the positive impact diversification has had on the overall portfolio performance.

Due to the claims activity seen in the second half of the year and capital requirements following the Japanese typhoons, market rate increases are also expected in 2020 on the catastrophe impacted lines of business.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: All risks were underwritten in the UK and relate to property reinsurance and cyber business

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) is printed as a single Gross figure in the notes. The technical provisions note provides gross 'movement in the provision' (28,342.1 $'000) which is the total year movement (includes current year activity) and therefore was rejected per instructions. A gross claims development table (percentages and gross claims liabilities by underwriting year) is present but does not provide a straightforward single gross prioryear movement figure without reconstructing diagonals; given ambiguity and potential RITC/closure effects the explicit prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. All amounts taken from the financial statements are presented in the native currency (USD) and converted to millions by dividing $'000 figures by 1,000.
